name: pi-turetryphy-c7c53c4c2-tc-hm10-cl
element: HBM protected TU PHY retry port
purpose: phys-intake 2026-10-09 (owner: start physical work on every 'implementation recorded (no physical job)' element; dual-track '-cl' line). Exact bench + mutant: physical/phys_intake/bench.sh hbm_tu_retry_phy (pos PASS / mutant FAIL on this source).
